mode.title: Search mode
mode.description: Whether to collect funding opportunities or local vendors.

query.title: Query
query.description: Free-text search query, for example 'MSME loan' or 'tailor'.

businessCategory.title: Business category
businessCategory.description: Optional SME category used when searching for funding.

serviceCategory.title: Service category
serviceCategory.description: Optional vendor category such as tailor, baker, shoemaker, printer or packaging.

state.title: State
state.description: Nigerian state to focus the search, for example Lagos or Kano.

locality.title: Locality
locality.description: City, LGA or neighbourhood within the selected state.

fundingType.title: Funding type
fundingType.description: Optional funding filter. Ignored when mode is vendors.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of valid records to push to the dataset. Hard cap is 50.
